description: This is a Java interface defining methods for reading and retrieving GLIM (Group Loan Individual Monitoring) account information in a loan account service of the Fineract project.

methods.name: findGlimAccountsByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts associated with a specific group ID.

methods.name: findGlimAccountByGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts by group ID (duplicates in name indicating possible different implementations).

methods.name: findGlimAccount
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM account details for a specific group ID.

methods.name: findGlimAccountByGroupIdandAccountNo
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts for a specified group ID and account number.

methods.name: findGlimAccountbyGroupAndAccount
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts by group ID and account number (similar to previous, possibly different implementation).

methods.name: findGlimAccountByParentAccountId
methods.description: Finds GLIM accounts by parent account IDs.

methods.name: findGlimaccountsByGLIMId
methods.description: Retrieves GLIM accounts related to a specific GLIM ID.

methods.name: findglimRepaymentTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the repayment template associated with a specific GLIM ID.
